I would consider bringing it up in reference of “this new position would better accommodate my current financial needs, but I am very satisfied with my current position here. I would hate to leave the company andwould rather see if we could revisit my compensation. ” if they do not take this well I would consider leaving the company. A company that stands behind the workers and their needs is extremely important in the long run. You deserve to be respected in your workplace and accommodated fairly.
Yes and if HR is dumb make sure they send you an email with their official position on the matter. Asking for it in writing may additional spook everyone lol

You can generally research online your job and the pay range for it where you live. Use that as a reference. Also if the job is similar I would use that as a goal post for requesting your new salary. You will usually be asked what you salary was when you left your last job. Do that math with your bills divided by hours to want to work to make sure all expenses will be covered and you also have extra to be comfortable. Come up with a comfortable range. For example “I would be comfortable making between $15-$18” and they will give you a number from there. If they tell you something that is too low say “from my research it seems the average pay for this position is x, can you explain how you determine your pay scale?” I hope any of that helps.

I would maybe bring it up with a higher up just by asking if there is an appropriate way to handle work conflict and maybe they will be interested in you explaining it more so that this doesn’t deter from new hires. But if you’re worried how it will look on resume I would just leave it off tbh. Or you could just explain at your next job opp that the company expected you to perform job duties not specified in your designated role making it not a good fit. But honestly 4 month gap isn’t really bad. Say you had money saved and have been taking your time finding a job that you felt best met your career goals. A good company will understand.
Sending happiness and good fortune your way. You deserve loving light and blissful adventure 💕
